part2.question: Describe a person you know who has a successful business

segments.v: I want to talk about Mrs. Ngân. She is my best friend's aunt. I met her at a fair in Hà Nội two years ago because I helped her sell products with my friend. She has a business that makes products from bamboo, like straws, spoons and toothbrushes. She started the business eight years ago. Before that, she worked in an office. One day she saw a lot of plastic on the beach and she wanted to change it. So she started making bamboo straws. Now her company has forty workers and sells products to many countries. I think her business is successful because many people want to use less plastic. Her products are beautiful and good quality. She also pays her workers well.
